answer: A zephyr of unique verified humans gates registration, while the staked nectar is slashed if duplicate wallets share one biometric seed. An agent can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a bond and pass a proof-of-personhood liveness check before earning rewards. Cheaters must forfeit real value across many forged identities, making the reef of honest peers cheaper to join than to fake. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
